protocol.role: independent cold exact trajectory compute confirmation

excluded_actions.reason: resident class has no arrivals in the three-class q01 protocol

protocol.arrival_model: independent class-wise Poisson arrivals using stream key aligned-frame:{seed}:{coordinate}
protocol.fixed_tape_rule: construct exactly one immutable tape for each (lanes, load, seed) and use it once for the registered cold trajectory

selector_rule.initialization: fresh roots and frontier in every frame
selector_rule.early_stop: the call returns before the cap when the certified frontier upper bound equals the feasible incumbent score
selector_rule.accounting: sum each returned call's actual native work fields

protocol.online_information: each call receives only the current released queue, fixed catalogue, lane count, and K4096 cap
protocol.dispatch: global synchronous frames, FIFO within class, with arrivals during a frame eligible only at the next frame boundary
protocol.stopping_rule: stop arrivals at 600 seconds and drain the finite tape to completion

mean_utilization.quantity: sum actual LP calls / (4096 * visited frame count)

empirical_p95.quantity: actual LP calls in one visited frame / 4096
empirical_p95.claim: descriptive empirical tail gate on registered frames

matrix_work_accounting.derivation: option_count * (one lane row + queue_dimension resource rows + option_count box rows)
matrix_work_accounting.interpretation: a non-executed worst-case coefficient envelope; actual selector matrix cells are summed directly and no actual comparison baseline is claimed
matrix_work_accounting.gate: actual matrix sum must not exceed the arithmetic cap envelope; no matrix-utilization threshold is a scientific gate

registered_gate: one selector call per visited frame and every call is exact within K4096
all jobs complete; queue recursion, FIFO decomposition, and every returned certificate are valid
no ordered-action or count-vector enumeration occurs in trajectories
actual LP mean utilization is strictly below five percent in every case and aggregate
empirical frame-level p95 actual LP work is at most ten percent of the cap in every case and aggregate
all actual LP and matrix work totals reconstruct from per-frame records

decision_rule.INVALID_EXECUTION: one or more registered execution-integrity checks fail
decision_rule.COLD_EXACT_COMPUTE_CONFIRMATION_PASS: every visited frame closes exactly within one cold K4096 call; actual LP utilization is below five percent in every R/load case and in aggregate; and empirical frame-level p95 LP work is at most ten percent of the cap in every case and in aggregate
decision_rule.COLD_EXACT_COMPUTE_CONFIRMATION_FAIL_STO: execution is valid but one or more frozen exactness or empirical bounded-compute gates fail

protocol.claim_boundary: An independent registered finite-horizon trajectory compute confirmation on eight fresh Poisson seeds per load for point-model synthetic identical-lane R8 and R16 systems. It establishes empirical work on these visited frames only. It is not an all-queue theorem, a performance advantage over another policy, a stability proof, joint95 physical closure, a physical multi-GPU measurement, or a deployment decision.
protocol.prohibited: post-result changes to seeds, horizon, loads, cap, utilization gates, or endpoints; restart or warm-start retries; an executed comparison policy; ordered-action or count-vector enumeration in trajectories; future-arrival access; paper or README edits

claim_boundary: An independent registered finite-horizon trajectory compute confirmation on eight fresh Poisson seeds per load for point-model synthetic identical-lane R8 and R16 systems. It establishes empirical work on these visited frames only. It is not an all-queue theorem, a performance advantage over another policy, a stability proof, joint95 physical closure, a physical multi-GPU measurement, or a deployment decision.
limitations: The LP utilization and p95 statements are empirical summaries of the registered visited frames, not worst-case complexity bounds.
The matrix denominator is a non-executed cap envelope, not measured work from a competing baseline.
The finite 600-second point-model tapes are drained completely but do not establish steady-state or physical performance.
next_step: Preserve the registered result for code-first synthesis while the separate joint95 physical collection remains open.
